verdict.rationale: Shopify ships an official CLI, installed with `npm install -g @shopify/ucp-cli`. Its structured commands cover catalog search, carts, checkouts, buyer handoff (UCP_ON_ESCALATION) and order tracking, and it supports `--input-schema` introspection, a local agent profile, and an AI Toolkit skill that maps natural-language requests to CLI commands. A runtime probe confirmed the CLI searched the live catalog and created a real cart. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of the checkout, handoff and order-tracking commands (the probe stopped at cart creation), and no published full CLI command reference in evidence.
